strict_conclusion: No currently reachable exact anonymous operation qualifies. Touchstone is the closest semantic match but its arbitrary-URL verification is caller-run and Touchstone-format-specific. Arcaeon is the closest substantive hosted action but now requires a bearer key. NANDA Daily is the closest NANDA runtime but lacks an exact request schema and declares did-auth.
